prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center(Juniper): retains reports/rationale/timestamps/routes/transfers/audit evidence under approved access/retention controls; tracks coverage/surge; produces Unit Staging Change Card; checks Battery Swap Voucher/North Approach Queue Snapshot; uses Caller Location Correction Slip; maintains emergency-first degraded-radio/common-picture procedures; records restriction rationale/scope/duration; periodically compares service measures with approved thresholds. Call Taker Mara(Larkspur): verifies location/incident/facility; produces correction slip; checks Bedside Arrival Receipt; captures pediatric observations; keeps callers connected during alternate-channel attempts when feasible. Triage Supervisor(Copperfield): resolves/documents uncertainty; sends Pediatric Acuity Note; validates prioritization/surge/overrides; reviews duplicate closures and acuity/escalation-related patient risk. Capture precedes triage; reassessment mandatory; threats require highest-available priority/prompt dispatch; clarification cannot delay; pediatric airway/breathing/circulation/mental-status concerns require protocol-approved escalation. Regional Medical Director: clinical/delegation/surge/destination/protocol advice; reviews clinical findings; approves guidance within regional authority; no dispatch authority. Data Quality Officer(Pebble): flags/routes defects; reviews handovers/discrepancies/timestamp conflicts without delaying care; cannot reprioritize. Jurisdictions own policy/boundaries. Computer Aided Dispatch Console: incidents/resources/access/staging/surge/constraints; verify latest confirmed status/time/source; approved-scenario testing before regional-change authorization. Ambulance Coordination Platform: priority/capability/availability/constraint matching; timestamped movements/destinations/instructions; separate accepted-mutual-aid tracking; interrupted-update queues/reconciliation; monitor availability/response-time/integrity/interface failures; assess operational/clinical/security/continuity impacts before release. Dispatchers compare response-time/coverage; failed voice requires approved available data channel/timestamped attempts; restoration requires reconciliation/preserved discrepancies. Shift Commander(Sundial): receives capacity alerts/Coverage Gap Bulletin; staffing/deployment/exception approvals; sends Mutual Aid Release Form; coordinates surge/handover; authority until acknowledged successor/takeover; cannot override clinical/crew authority; may restrict unacceptable-risk capabilities. Radio Coordinator(Mistral): reachability/backups/talkgroups; assignments/hazards/destinations/retries/alerts; uses South Access Lane Notice. Regional Radio Network/interfaces: post-maintenance/configuration checks before normal use. Fleet Maintenance Cell: uses Mutual Aid Release Form; preventive scheduling follows manufacturer/history/regional requirements; records

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
